headline: Stema Landing Erupts as Fishermans Row Battles On
war_summary: Since the last edition, Stema Landing has exploded onto the base board with four actions in the past two hours, the latest at 23:52, making it the hottest point on the map. Fishermans Row remains locked in its grinding fight, tallying three fresh moves in the latest two-hour window and twenty-three over the past day, with Peripti Landing and Dankana Post still drawing the heaviest traffic. Godcrofts, after a lull, has renewed itself with a fresh event at 23:25. Lykos Isle, quiet earlier, has come back to life with three actions in the six-hour column, though its two-hour count is empty. DeadLands, despite a robust twenty-four-hour ledger of sixteen changes, has produced nothing since 19:02, and Farranac Coast holds still at 17:50, while Linn Mercy has not stirred since early morning. Tempest Island shows a lone neutralization at 21:23. Away from the base board, Clahstra and Weathered Expanse continue to run staggering casualty totals without any strategic bases changing hands. The war is now in its eightieth day.
